question: List the names of singers who performed in at least one concert.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.Name FROM singer AS s JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID
candidate_sql:
SELECT s.Name
FROM singer AS s
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM singer_in_concert AS sic
    JOIN concert AS c ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
    WHERE sic.Singer_ID = CAST(s.Singer_ID AS VARCHAR)
);
